Displays for every occasion

Pick a ready-made display, or add a name and a line of your own for $25. Every display comes with the celebration letters, 10 or more signs and images, and full setup and takedown.

Happy Birthday

Our most-booked display. Big letters, balloons, cakes, gifts and their favourite things worked in around the message.

It could readHAPPY 10th BIRTHDAY JOHN

Graduation

Caps, diplomas, class year and school colours. A front-yard announcement the whole street gets to share in.

It could readCONGRATS KATE, CLASS OF 2026

Anniversary

Milestone years deserve more than a card. Hearts, flowers and the number of years, spelled out across the lawn.

It could readHAPPY ANNIVERSARY RICH & MITZI

New baby Boy or Girl displays, birth announcements and welcome-home baby surprises.

Just married Engagements and wedding-day displays for the newlyweds’ first lawn.

Welcome home For homecomings, new houses and long-awaited returns.

Retirement Cheers to the years, send them off in letters two feet tall.

How it works

No setup, no cleanup, no spoiling the surprise. Here is the whole job, start to finish.

1

You book the date

Choose your display and date below, or call 306-934-LAWN. Tell us whose lawn, and what the display should say.

2

We sneak in early

Displays go up in the early morning, typically 5:00 to 7:00am, before the house wakes up. You get 12 to 14 hours with it, plenty of time for photos.

3

We take it all down

We return between 6:00 to 8:00pm and remove everything. Want to keep the party going? Overnight rental is available for $50.

Simple, flat pricing

One price covers the display, delivery, setup and takedown. No hourly math, no surprises on the invoice.

Questions, answered

The things people ask us most. Anything else, call 306-934-5296, we love to help.

Standard displays are $99 for the day, plus GST and PST, including delivery, setup and takedown. You can customize any display with a name or special saying (up to 20 characters) for an additional $25, and fully custom special-occasion displays are $124.

We serve Saskatoon, Warman, Corman Park, Martensville, Aberdeen, Osler and Hague. Delivery is free in Saskatoon, Warman and Martensville; other areas are typically $20,$75. Don’t see your town? Give us a call, we would love to help you out.

A typical display is yours for 12 to 14 hours. We set up early in the morning (all displays are in place by 7am) and pick up in the evening, with 8pm the latest pickup. Exact times can’t be guaranteed, only time slots, but we will always work with your day.

Nope! We deliver, set up, and return to take down the display for you. You simply enjoy it, and maybe take a few pictures.

Yes, overnight displays are available for an extra $50, picked up before 10am the following day. Email info@letterthelawn.ca for an overnight booking.

The celebrations keep going. From November 1 to March 31 (or until the ground is warm enough to stake), displays go on wooden stands instead of stakes. Some messages are abbreviated to fit, HAPPY BDAY instead of HAPPY BIRTHDAY, but it is the same big surprise.

Weekends and grad season book up fast. Check your date in the estimator above, or just call us, we answer fast and we love a good surprise plan.
